Definition: The complex was divided into 4 main nuclei (superior, lateral, medial, descending). Small cell groups were ignored (nucleus parasolitarius, group y) or absorbed into one of the 4 (interstitial nucleus of the vestibular nerve and group l into the lateral; groups f, x and z into the descending; nucleus supravestibularis into the medial), following Baron 1977.
Note: matters when pooling with sources that delineate the complex differently

Definition: Brains fixed in Bouin's fluid (a few in 10% formalin), paraffin, frontal serial sections, cresyl-violet and Heidenhain-Woelcke. 5-8 sections per nucleus at equal intervals were projected on photographic paper, delineated, cut out and weighed; V = AP x WS x D/M2. Section volumes were converted to estimated fresh volumes following Stephan et al. 1981.
Note: same shrinkage-correction basis as the rest of the Stephan/Dusseldorf series
